description_en: Provides T1-tier international distribution partners with a list of all commission-eligible commodities that are in the "Active" or "Delisted" status. This operation is available only for international users and cannot be called on the China site
description_zh: 向T1层级的国际分销伙伴提供所有“生效中“、”已下架“的返佣商品列表。只针对国际用户，国内站无法调用
kebab_example: aliyun agency get-commissionable-products --page-no 1 --page-size 1 --list-show-status-list ONLINE --commodity-code-list oceanbase_obpre_public_intl,savingplan_common_public_intl --pip-code-list oceanbase --real-start-month '“202502”' --real-end-month '“202509”' --fiscal-year '“FY26”' --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCommissionableProducts

parameters.help_en: The current page number for pagination. The value starts from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页，当前页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页每页记录数，最大值100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of display statuses for commission commodities
parameters.help_zh: 返佣商品的展示状态列表
parameters.name: list_show_status_list

parameters.help_en: The commodity codes. Separate multiple codes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 商品code,多个code使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: commodity_code_list

parameters.help_en: The product codes. Separate multiple codes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 产品code,多个code使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: pip_code_list

parameters.help_en: The actual start month in the format of "yyyymm"
parameters.name: real_start_month

parameters.help_en: The actual end month in the format of "yyyymm"
parameters.name: real_end_month

parameters.help_en: The fiscal year. If this parameter is left empty, the current fiscal year is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 财年，输入为空时默认当前财年
parameters.name: fiscal_year
